result:
The proposed answer of 10 is most likely incorrect. I could not verify it from first principles here, and I am relying on recollection of the literature.

The cited source is also doubtful. The proposal attributes the classification to A. Yap, but the relevant work on rational preperiodic points for quadratic rational maps with nonabelian automorphism groups over Q is, to my recollection, by J. Doyle. I recall that result giving a sharp bound of 12 rational preperiodic points, not 10. The claim that A₄ is the extremal case is also unsupported, and I cannot confirm that A₄ occurs as an automorphism group over Q for this family in the way the proposal assumes.

Since the proposal rests on a misattributed classification and an unverified extremal case, I would not accept 10 as the maximum.

VERDICT: REJECT
